_meta.description: Cross-cutting parity: HookExecutorImpl 4-arm dispatch matrix. Validates Builtin/Http/Command/Agent arms each produce the expected outcome under PreToolUse + PostToolUse events.

arms.name: Builtin
arms.notes: In-process handler registered via register_builtin(). Returns whatever HookResult the handler produces.

arms.name: Http
arms.ssrf_guard: loopback and RFC-1918 addresses blocked by default
arms.notes: HTTP POST to endpoint; SSRF guard validates host before dispatch.

arms.name: Command
arms.notes: The Command arm is wired through ProcessRunner + Sandbox and sends the serialized hook envelope on stdin. An executor without those platform seams still returns the structured 'command executor not wired' error.

arms.name: Agent
arms.notes: Without a SubagentSpawner attached, returns HookOutcome::Error with stderr containing 'agent executor not wired'.
